refreshToken.title: Sensi Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: Paste a Sensi refresh_token (from a POST to oauth.sensiapi.io/token). Or run: node ~/homebridge-sensi-fan/sensi-setup.js --login

fanSwitchSuffix.title: Fan Switch Name Suffix
fanSwitchSuffix.description: The fan switch is named '<Thermostat Name> <suffix>'. ON = fan runs continuously, OFF = fan returns to auto.

clientId.title: OAuth Client ID
clientId.description: Must match the client that issued the refresh token: 'ios' or 'android' for tokens captured from the mobile app, 'fleet' for the web portal.

clientSecret.title: OAuth Client Secret
clientSecret.description: Required when Client ID is not 'fleet'.
